cohort: same frozen 251 entry trade_ids; 16/32/64 day existing 60/40 split and 1h embargo
strict_path_gate: path_complete=true; missing S5 endpoints, boundary bars and within-S5 ordering are never relaxed

common_execution.action_time: completed feature bar signal becomes active at the next OANDA S5
common_execution.long_exit: OANDA bid; short exit: OANDA ask
common_execution.market_or_partial_fill: next S5 side-correct open plus an additional adverse half-spread slippage bound
common_execution.stop_fill: stop level unless the first eligible S5 opens through it adversely; add adverse half-spread slippage bound
common_execution.unknown_cost: candidate actual_after_cost_net=null; retain diagnostic executable-price PnL separately
common_execution.baseline: corrected V2 actual after-cost trade cash flow

arms.BASELINE: actual OANDA terminal path and corrected V2 cash flow
arms.FIXED_BE: after 60% progress to the then-active TP, arm stop at entry on the next S5
arms.ALL_COST_BE: same trigger but stop recovers causal fee, financing accrued through exit, and slippage bound; missing schedule is ineligible
arms.PARTIAL_TP_BE: after +1 entry-frozen ATR, close 50% rounded down to 100 units at next S5 and arm entry stop for runner; entry units must be >=2000 and runner >=1000
arms.PURE_ATR_TRAIL: after +1 entry-frozen ATR, ratchet once per completed M1 to OANDA favorable extreme minus/plus 1.5 current causal ATR; next S5 activation
arms.SMA_DETERIORATION_TRAIL: existing completed-M1 hard contradiction (aligned SMA20 slope and SMA20-SMA50 distance negative with worsening slope and MA distance) must persist 3 bars; full exit next S5
arms.STRUCTURE_BREAK_EXIT: completed feature-only M1 close crosses the prior 5 completed-bar low for LONG or high for SHORT; full exit next S5
arms.TIME_EXIT: full exit at first OANDA S5 at or after 30 minutes from actual fill

feature_boundary: Dukascopy complete M1 is feature-only. It may emit ATR/SMA/structure signals but never supplies financial fill price.
adoption: 32d and 64d validation incremental net>0, paired LCB>0, PF>1, DD not worse, complete margin and fill/unwind evidence; no one-window adoption

cube.missing: null plus admission reason; never zero
